name: nw-skills
description: New Ward skills as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: nw-skills
plugins.description: New Ward skills: Michael Ezehi's agent skills and slash commands for engineering, design, writing and strategy.

plugins.name: savvy-progress
plugins.description: Progress bar and agents panel with pixel crabs, on the desktop and in any truecolor terminal (fork of johnnyvizz/claude-kit, MIT)

plugins.name: agent-bar
plugins.description: Keeps the savvy-progress bar on for every task

plugins.name: guard-rails
plugins.description: Blocks git commands that sweep other agents' work, and dashes in commit text

plugins.name: session-pane
plugins.description: /session-pane: files changed this session and the latest tool calls

plugins.name: turn-chime
plugins.description: A chime and a toast when a long turn finishes

plugins.name: devdeck
plugins.description: Live mirror of a Devdeck dev dashboard: service dots, the latest hot reload or Convex call above the prompt, /devdeck for the full pane, and tools to read it, run package scripts in it and restart services

plugins.name: callouts
plugins.description: Makes what needs you impossible to miss: action, question and input blocks in a reply draw as bright yellow cards with a flag and stay pinned above the prompt with buttons or a field to answer; done blocks draw as a finished banner
